data.action: 立于山巅仰望银河伸臂虚握流星
data.camera: wide shot, standing on a mountain peak with one arm outstretched
data.description: 【令 · 云海山巅观星】绝顶之上，云海在脚下翻涌成浪，银河横贯天际。令立于山巅青石之上，极长的蓝发在夜风中如瀑飘散，龙角映着星辉，墨青旗袍的下摆轻轻翻飞。她抬手虚握一颗流星的余光，声音飘渺如吟——「朝菌不知晦朔，蟪蛄不知春秋。而我看过太多春秋，仍觉得人间有趣。」
data.lighting: starry sky glow, pale blue moonlight, drifting cloud mist rim light
data.promptProse: Above a rolling cloud sea, Ling stands on a blue-stone mountain crest and extends one arm toward a meteor's fading trail. Her extremely long blue hair and ink-teal robe stream in the night wind. The wide composition leaves the Milky Way above and clouds below the ledge. Pale blue moonlight edges her horns and sleeves, with darker stone beneath her feet.
data.title: 令 · 云海山巅观星
